text:
maria (sales): Quick sync — Acme wants an air-gapped POC next quarter. Key asks: signed offline bundle, delta upgrades, HSM/KMS for keys, and a predictable upgrade cadence they can run during maintenance windows. They also asked about hotfixes and rollback strategy.
kevin (sales-eng): Got it. Do we know target infra? (k8s on-prem with restricted egress) Any kernel/OS constraints?
maria (sales): They said RHEL 8.8, no outbound, internal registry only. 2 control plane VMs + 3 worker nodes for the inference pool.
anita (security): For offline bundles we need SBOM + signature verification. Recommend bundle signing via customer HSM or our signed attestations. Also will need a cert rotation plan for RPC/TLS.
raj (solutions-eng): Operationally we support delta-bundles today via chunked diffs. For fully offline installs we provide a signed tarball + metadata manifest. We can support staged rollouts (canary node label + drain/upgrade). Cadence: advise quarterly security + monthly critical hotfix.
maria (sales): They asked pricing impact: does delta vs full bundle change license or engineering effort?
kevin (sales-eng): No license delta. Work effort for delta bundles (airgap packaging) is scoped per-customer for the first few months (we do initial bundling + automation). After that it's normal patch cadence. Suggest add one-time POC packaging fee.
anita (security): Need to confirm their KMS flow. If they want HSM-imported keys we ship the bundle unsigned and provide verification tooling that uses their KMS public key. If they want us to sign, we need an NDA + key escrow discussion.
raj (solutions-eng): FYI for hotfixes we can produce 'micro-bundles' that are <50MB and apply to affected components only. Rollback implemented via prior manifest + image unpack. We log checksums and publish a signed manifest. Example manifest snippet: 
```
name: redwood-offline-bundle
version: 2026.03.01
components:
  - runtime: rdx-runtime-1.4.2
  - kernel-patches: rdx-kp-12
sha256: "..."
signature: "..."
```
maria (sales): Nice — they also flagged legal: audit trail for upgrades and proof-of-integrity is required for FedRAMP-ish customers.
anita (security): We can provide audit logs and signed manifests. Need to confirm retention window. Also confirm whether they need FIPS-validated crypto libraries in the bundle.
kevin (sales-eng): Ask: do they want automated delta generation from our release train or a manual pull model? Two options: 
- automated: we push diffs; they approve in staging, then pull; requires secure outbound channel at staging time.
- manual: we produce signed bundles on demand and provide S3 / physical transfer options.
maria (sales): I'll ask them which workflow they prefer. Also need to confirm maintenance window SLA (2-4 hours typical?).
raj (solutions-eng): For maintenance windows <4h we recommend pre-staging micro-bundles on nodes (offline cache). Otherwise full upgrade could exceed window for large model artifacts.
deploy-bot: release-bundle 1.4.3-airgap created (id: rb-20260301-77) :package:
kevin (sales-eng): That release has the micro-bundle tooling we can demo in POC. I'll prep a short demo script and an ops runbook.
maria (sales): Perfect. Action items: 1) I ask customer for preferred transfer workflow and maintenance window. 2) Kevin to prepare demo + runbook. 3) Anita to draft KMS/HSM checklist + SBOM requirements. 4) Raj to outline rollback and staging steps.
anita (security): I'll include cert rotation cadence, FIPS checkbox, and expected attestation flow.
kevin (sales-eng): ETA for runbook: EOD Wednesday.
raj (solutions-eng): I'll drop an ops checklist link once ready: https://internal.redwood/ops/airgap-runbook (preview).
maria (sales): Thanks team — I'll update Acme and circle back with their answers. :thumbsup:
